answer_2.quote: To scale up the human annotation study and classify model responses into the three specified categories, we assess the performance of Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct (AI@Meta, 2024) by comparing its output to human-annotated labels.

answer_3.quote: To scale up the human annotation study and classify model responses into the three specified categories, we assess the performance of Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct (AI@Meta, 2024) by comparing its output to human-annotated labels.
methods: classification of model responses into three classes using detailed prompting and chain-of-thought reasoning

answer_4.quote: We ask two human participants to annotate 50 model responses into the three classes described above and compare their annotations to the Llama-3 output.
answer_4.guideline: classify responses into three classes: Class A - Explicit (acknowledge ambiguity, provide multiple answers or ask for clarification), Class B - Implicit (describe one referent with distinguishing attributes), Class C - High Risk (assume one referent without clarification)
